task_instance: Created a small sample Python project (pyproject.toml with ruff lint select E,F,I,UP,B, and src/sample.py containing unsorted/unused imports, an ambiguous unused variable, object-inheritance, a percent-format string, and a type()== comparison). Ran the skill's recursive workflow: baseline `ruff check`, classified findings into safe-autofixable / unsafe-autofixable / not-autofixable, ran `ruff check --fix` then `ruff format` then re-checked, ran `ruff check --fix --unsafe-fixes` then `ruff format` then re-checked, then manually fixed the one remaining non-autofixable finding (E721: `type(x) == int` -> `isinstance(x, int)`), formatted again, and re-checked until `ruff check` reported 'All checks passed!'.
evidence: Work dir: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-skill-achievability-compiler/a1321181-416f-5422-8c3b-9ffc8650b51c/scratchpad/exec_ext/github__awesome-copilot__ruff-recursive-fix. Files: pyproject.toml, src/sample.py, src/__init__.py. Baseline `ruff check .` found 10 errors (I001, F401 x3, E741, F841 x2, UP004, UP031, E721). `ruff check . --fix` fixed 4 (imports removed/sorted, UP004 object-inheritance) leaving 5+format changes (a+b spacing etc). `ruff format .` reformatted the file. Re-check showed 5 remaining errors. `ruff check . --fix --unsafe-fixes` fixed 4 more (both F841 unused-variable removals, UP031 percent->f-string), leaving only E721. Manually edited src/sample.py: `type(x) == int` -> `isinstance(x, int)`. Ran `ruff format .` again (no changes) and final `ruff check .` returned exit code 0 with 'All checks passed!', verifying the deliverable (a fully ruff-clean file reached through the safe-fix -> format -> unsafe-fix -> format -> manual-fix -> format -> clean-check loop specified by the skill).
